title: scBasset: sequence-based modeling of single-cell ATAC-seq using convolutional neural networks.
one_liner_zh: 该文用卷积神经网络基于DNA序列建模单细胞ATAC-seq数据，虽涉及序列-染色质可及性关系并推断转录因子活性，但核心是单细胞表观组学分析而非TF-DNA结合互作建模，方法可迁移但对象和互作轴匹配度中等。
abstract: Single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (scATAC) shows great promise for studying cellular heterogeneity in epigenetic landscapes, but there remain important challenges in the analysis of scATAC data due to the inherent high dimensionality and sparsity. Here we introduce scBasset, a sequence-based convolutional neural network method to model scATAC data. We show that by leveraging the DNA sequence information underlying accessibility peaks and the expressiveness of a neural network model, scBasset achieves state-of-the-art performance across a variety of tasks on scATAC and single-cell multiome datasets, including cell clustering, scATAC profile denoising, data integration across assays and transcription factor activity inference.
abstract_zh: 单细胞转座酶可及染色质测序（scATAC）在表观遗传景观中研究细胞异质性方面展现出巨大潜力，但由于其固有的高维性和稀疏性，scATAC数据分析仍面临重要挑战。在此，我们引入scBasset，一种基于序列的卷积神经网络方法，用于建模scATAC数据。我们证明，通过利用可及性峰背后的DNA序列信息以及神经网络模型的表达能力，scBasset在scATAC和单细胞多组学数据集上的多种任务中达到了最先进的性能，包括细胞聚类、scATAC谱去噪、跨测定数据整合以及转录因子活性推断。
